chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Hassan narrated to me from Ismail ibn Mihran, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from his father, from Abi Basir, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever recites Surah al-Waqi'ah every Friday night, Allah will love him and make him beloved to all people. He will not see misfortune, poverty, destitution, or any calamity of the world. He will be among the companions of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him). This Surah is specifically for the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), and no one else shares in it.

key_terms.الوَاقِعَهَ: Surah al-Waqi'ah (The Event), a chapter of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of reciting Surah al-Waqi'ah on Friday night according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith emphasizes the Friday night (Laylat al-Jumu'ah) recitation of Surah al-Waqi'ah as a means to secure divine affection and universal popularity, while specifically guarding against poverty and calamities. It further establishes a unique spiritual affinity between this Surah and Imam Ali (peace be upon him), suggesting that the reciter becomes among his companions in the hereafter, a concept deeply rooted in Shia devotional practices regarding the Ahl al-Bayt's connection to the Quran.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to me by Ahmad b. Idris who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ahmad who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ahmad from Ismail b. Mihran from al-Hassan b. Ali from his father from Abi Basir from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “

One who recites Surah Waqiya every Friday eve, Allah would love him and create his love in the hearts of the people. He would keep that person away from misfortune, poverty, helplessness and calamities of the world. That person will be among the companions of Amirul Momineen (a.s.). This Surah is completely related to Amirul Momineen (a.s.) only and no one else.”
